# Exende API context

Canonical website: https://www.exende.dev

Exende is a public-facing data product centered on Jobs & Hiring Data. It also provides three separate production infrastructure APIs for AI agents and automated workflows. The Exende website and customer application are separate from the protected DataAPI operator dashboard.

## Jobs & Hiring Data

Purpose: provide reviewed public hiring data, current catalogue counts, and historical observation for legitimate market research, recruiting analytics, and data products.

- Product: https://www.exende.dev/products/jobs
- Documentation: https://www.exende.dev/docs/jobs
- Public overview endpoint: GET https://data.exende.dev/v1/public/overview
- Overview authentication: none
- Fields: `active_jobs`, `active_companies`, `active_sources`, and nullable ISO 8601 UTC `last_updated_at`
- Cache-Control: `public, max-age=60, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=600`
- Overview boundary: aggregate values only
- Customer API base: https://data.exende.dev
- Customer authentication, onboarding credits, and scoped API keys: available
- Paid subscriptions and plan upgrades: available through the authenticated dashboard

Customer credit metering:

- Failed requests consume 0 credits.
- Per-record routes that return no records consume 0 credits.
- Jobs search, jobs list, job history, company jobs, skills, and history-feed routes cost 1 credit per returned record.
- A single job detail costs 1 credit; company detail and metrics overview cost 2 credits; company hiring and hiring metrics cost 5 credits.
- List and search routes accept up to 100 records per request.

The public overview does not return job listings, company profiles, descriptions, source health, failed runs, raw payloads, protected history, customer records, API-key data, or operational incidents. It must not be presented as complete global or guaranteed real-time coverage.

## Infrastructure APIs

Callback, Retry, and Resolve are operated through machine-readable HTTP without a mandatory dashboard. x402-paid creation uses exact USDC settlement on Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`). These products are separate from the Jobs Data subscription and scoped customer-key model.

## Callback API

Purpose: create a temporary public webhook endpoint, receive external POST/PUT/PATCH events, then read or long-poll them with a private read token.

- Management base: https://api.exende.dev
- Public receiver: https://cb.exende.dev
- Create: POST /v1/callbacks
- Read events: GET /v1/callbacks/{id}/events
- Wait: GET /v1/callbacks/{id}/wait?timeout=1..30&after={event_id}
- Delete: DELETE /v1/callbacks/{id}
- Price: $0.01 USDC per callback creation through x402 v2
- Limits: 10-minute lifetime, 10 events, 262144 bytes per event
- Authentication: creation uses x402; follow-up reads/waits/deletion use the returned `read_token`
- Canonical docs: https://www.exende.dev/docs/callback
- OpenAPI: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/callback.json

## Retry API v1

Purpose: execute a public HTTPS request as a durable job with automatic retry scheduling, recovery, status polling, attempt history, and an optional signed terminal callback.

- Base: https://retry.exende.dev
- Create: POST /v1/retries
- Status: GET /v1/retries/{id}
- Attempts: GET /v1/retries/{id}/attempts
- Callback status: GET /v1/retries/{id}/callback
- Cancel: POST /v1/retries/{id}/cancel (API-key jobs only)
- Usage: GET /v1/usage (API key only)
- Paid price: $0.02 USDC per x402-paid job; internal attempts are included
- Paid limits: up to 8 attempts and a 24-hour lifetime
- API-key limit: up to 20 attempts
- Outbound security: public HTTPS only, up to 3 same-origin redirects, 20-second timeout across the complete chain
- Authentication: API key for account jobs; x402-paid creation returns a resource-scoped `read_token`
- Canonical docs: https://www.exende.dev/docs/retry
- OpenAPI: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/retry.json

## Resolve API v1

Purpose: resolve one public HTTP or HTTPS URL into bounded machine-readable web content, document text, structured data, text, or supported image metadata.

- Base: https://resolve.exende.dev
- Create: POST /v1/resolve
- Read: GET /v1/resolves/{id}
- Price: $0.03 USDC per job through x402 v2 exact on Base
- Inputs: `url` required; `output` is auto/markdown/text/json; `render` is auto/always/never
- Formats: static HTML, rendered HTML when needed, PDF text, JSON, CSV, XML-as-text, plain text, and PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP metadata
- Limits: 10 MiB download, 3 redirects, 30 seconds browser runtime, 250 content-bearing browser requests, 4 document navigations, 500 PDF pages, 512 KiB output
- Security: public standard-port HTTP/HTTPS only; direct IP, local/private/metadata/internal hosts, disallowed redirects, and private DNS results are rejected
- Retention: encrypted results are retained for 72 hours
- No OCR, archive extraction, screenshots, DOCX/XLSX extraction, internal retries, or LLM parsing in v1
- Authentication: x402-paid creation returns a job-scoped `read_token`; result reads require that token and no additional payment
- Canonical docs: https://www.exende.dev/docs/resolve
- OpenAPI: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/resolve.json

## x402

An unpaid creation request returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Build payment from those current requirements, repeat the same request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and read PAYMENT-RESPONSE after settlement. Retry and Resolve paid clients use the x402 v2 payment-identifier extension and reuse one identifier only for retries of the same logical paid request.

Canonical x402 docs: https://www.exende.dev/docs/x402
API catalog: https://www.exende.dev/api/catalog.json

## Jobs Data customer contract

- Jobs OpenAPI 3.1: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/jobs.json
- Developer quickstart: https://www.exende.dev/docs/jobs#quickstart
- Coverage and methodology: https://www.exende.dev/coverage
- Customer base URL: https://data.exende.dev
- Authentication: organization bearer API key; scoped jobs:read, companies:read, or signals:read.
- GET /v1/jobs/search requires q; GET /v1/jobs accepts optional q and normalized filters.
- GET /v1/jobs/{id}; GET /v1/jobs/{id}/history; GET /v1/history; GET /v1/skills.
- GET /v1/companies/{domain}; GET /v1/companies/{domain}/jobs; GET /v1/companies/{domain}/hiring.
- GET /v1/metrics/overview; GET /v1/metrics/hiring.
- Jobs list, search, and company jobs: default limit 50, maximum 100; pass nextCursor as cursor while retaining filters. Order: last_seen_at DESC, id DESC. Pages are not a frozen snapshot.
- Job history: up to 100 versions with limit, no cursor. Skills and history feed: latest/top 100, no pagination parameters.
- Hiring window: days 7–90, default 30. Hiring acceleration is null until historical readiness is met; it is not a prediction.
- Errors use error.code and error.message. Codes include unauthorized, insufficient_scope, invalid_request, rate_limited, insufficient_credits, not_found, service_unavailable.
- A Jobs Data 402 insufficient_credits response is not an x402 payment challenge. Callback, Retry, and Resolve have separate x402 contracts.
- The free allowance is 2,500 credits for 14 days for new verified organizations. Paid plan selection requires explicit checkout confirmation.
- Location text is not a normalized city. Country codes are nullable and require explicit supported evidence.

Public catalogue preview: GET https://data.exende.dev/v1/public/search?q=engineer (no key). q only, at most 80 characters and 6 terms. Returns actual active-job aggregates plus at most 5 restricted sample jobs from a fixed pool of at most 12 across all searches. No pagination, full descriptions, bulk export, customer data, or operator metadata. Country/location counts describe explicit country evidence and source location labels, not normalized cities. Full customer access requires a scoped Jobs Data API key. See https://www.exende.dev/docs/jobs#public-search.
